tex_content.html:
Given $w>0$, there is a decreasing function $\beta :[0,\infty )\ra (0,\infty ]$ with $\lim _{s\ra \infty }\beta (s)=0$ such that if $(x,t)\in M^+(w,t)\subset \M _t^+$, and $Z_t$ denotes the forward time slice $\M _t^+$ rescaled by $t^{-1}$, then

1. Some $(X,x)\in \La _w$ is $\beta (t)$-close to $(Z_t,(x,t))$.

2. $B(x,t,\beta (t)^{-1}\sqrt{t})\subset \M _t^+$ is unscathed on the interval $[t,2t]$ and if $\ga :[t,2t]\ra \M $ is a static curve starting at $(x,t)$, $\bar t\in [t,2t]$, then the map \begin{equation} B(x,t,\beta (t)^{-1}\sqrt{t})\ra P(x,t,\beta (t)^{-1}\sqrt{t},t)\cap \M _{\bar t} \end{equation} defined by following static curves induces a map \begin{equation} i_{t,\bar t}:(Z_t,(x,t))\supset (B(x,t,\beta (t)^{-1}),(x,t)) \ra (Z_{\bar t},\ga (\bar t)) \end{equation} satisfying \begin{equation} \| \left(i_{t,\bar t}\right)^*g_{Z_{\bar t}}-g_{Z_t}\| _{C^{\beta (t)^{-1}}} <\beta (t). \end{equation}

Proof

\sketch Apply the thick–thin decomposition and pointed smooth compactness. Hyperbolic rigidity and the approximation estimates give the required stabilization or geometric conclusion. ↗ lem:kl-noncollapsed-regions-lower-curvature-bound-almost-hyperbolic-large-scale-noncollapsing-lemma

□
